node.statement: Let B be the historical-to-modern compatibility assertion that every compact modern C^1 manifold is a Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead class-one manifold admitting an allowable atlas, and let T be the root conclusion. Nodes 1.1 and 1.2 furnish only B -> T: for an arbitrary compact modern C^1 manifold, B supplies the class-one status and allowable atlas, node 1.1 then supplies a finite allowable cover, and node 1.2 then supplies the finite-complex homeomorphism. Neither 1.1 nor 1.2 furnishes B. Consequently, if P is the scope-audit assertion in node 1.3 that the allowed inputs do not establish B, then Q follows: these dependencies establish only the conditional B -> T and do not establish T unconditionally; B must be added as an allowed input to complete this route. This is only a claim about what follows from the registered dependencies, not a claim that T is false.
